rachel: quick a11y sanity check please — putting the Model Activity modal + live inference panel behind canary tomorrow. main asks: table sorting semantics, live stream announcements, focus restore on close. screenshot: https://img.redwood.ai/UX/activity-modal.png jon: skimmed it. Table looks visually fine but VoiceOver reads each header as just the label. we should add `aria-sort` and `tabindex="0"` on headers so keyboard users can sort via Enter/Space. Example: `Started` priya: small nit: for screen readers aria-sort values need to toggle between `none`, `ascending`, `descending` — and update `aria-label` to include the sort hint. Also ensure the table uses role="table"/"row"/"cell" if it's implemented with divs. marco: about the live panel: currently we have an `aria-live="polite"` region that appends each token as it arrives. VoiceOver and NVDA both get noisy; recommend batching short messages and announcing a single status update like "Inference 1: streaming, 50%" rather than each token. Or use `aria-atomic="true"` and rewrite the entire status node every ~500ms. jess: agree. Also consider `role="status"` for transient updates and reserve `aria-live="assertive"` for errors only. Example pattern: ```
Streaming: 12 tokens
``` ben: found a keyboard trap: when the modal opens focus goes into the first interactive badge, but the last focusable item is a decorative close icon with `tabindex="0"`. That traps keyboard. Suggest removing tabindex on decorative elements and ensure focusable order matches logical flow, wrap with focus-trap library that returns focus to trigger on close. rachel: noted, will remove tabindex from the icon and add `aria-hidden="true"` for purely decorative svgs. jon: on charts in the modal — the mini throughput sparkline is an SVG without or <desc>. Screen readers skip it entirely. Add `<title>` and a short `<desc>` and set `role="img" aria-labelledby="sparkline-title sparkline-desc"`. Example: ``` <svg role="img" aria-labelledby="sparkline-title sparkline-desc"> <title id="sparkline-title">Throughput Tokens per second over the last 60s ... ``` priya: motion/accessibility: the live panel pulses a small glow with a 600ms animation. we should respect prefers-reduced-motion and disable the glow if the preference is enabled. CSS quick: `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .pulse { animation: none; } }` marco: copy nit for SR: the badge that reads "100% tokens used" is confusing. For screen reader announce `aria-label="Token budget: 100 percent used"` instead of raw percent text. jess: discovered a double-read bug: the close button has inner text "Close" and an `aria-label="Close modal"`. VoiceOver reads both. Use either inner text or aria-label but not both; if we need visible text, remove aria-label and add `aria-hidden="true"` on the icon only. ben: ran axe locally: issues flagged: duplicate ids in table rows (id reuse when rows are virtualized), missing alt/title on SVG, and low contrast on the focus ring in dark mode (token contrast ratio ~2.6:1). rachel: tickets created: UX-2987 (sortable table semantics + ids), UX-2988 (live region batching + status patterns), UX-2989 (modal focus trap & restore), UX-2990 (svg titles + alt), UX-2991 (focus ring contrast dark). I'll link PRs. a11y-bot: automated scan on branch `activity-modal-canary` completed: 5 new findings (see UX-2987..2991). Report: https://ci.redwood.ai/a11y/activity/2280001234 priya: implementation plan: 1) make headers keyboard-focusable and toggle aria-sort, 2) batch live updates and mark errors assertive only, 3) add svg title/desc and aria-hidden for decorative svgs, 4) respect prefers-reduced-motion, 5) fix focus ring color token. I can own 1 & 5. jon: I'll pair on the live batching and ARIA patterns this afternoon. rachel: can we get a quick mac+nvda smoke tomorrow morning before the 11am canary flip? tagging @jon @priya @ben — thanks all :rocket:
